**Back up first.** Before you install this version, make a backup in Settings › Backup & data.

**AI meals get real names**
- A photo or Describe meal is now named after the food, like "Banana" or "Chipotle chicken bowl", not "Snack" or "Lunch at 13:15".
- If the AI still gives a name like that, Forkcast names the meal after its main foods instead, for example "Rice, guacamole & chicken".
- Meals you already logged keep their names.

**Rename, Save as food, Favorite**
- Tap the pencil next to a name to rename it. Only that entry changes.
- The ⋮ menu at the top of an AI meal and of an entry's edit screen has Save as food, Favorite and Delete. A saved meal appears in My foods; favoriting it too doesn't make a second copy.
- Describe no longer saves the meal as a food on its own. Use ⋮ › Save as food when you want it.
- Meals from photos that you saved or starred now show in My foods too.
- What you typed with a photo shows under it, and stays after old photos are deleted.

**AI services**
- The arrows that set which AI goes first are now on each AI service, with a short note under "Your AI services".
- To add an AI service by hand, use Add AI › Advanced.
